independent_results.narrower_attack_no_live_container_replac: FORGED_POSITIVE (new finding; falsifies HQ235's single-primitive-closure sub-claim)

root_cause_one_line: The HQ235 gate compares attacker-supplied anchor FIELDS to the resolver's live containers but never binds the decision PAYLOAD (by_ref/by_key/authority_snapshots/custody_hash) to those containers, so a caller can set the anchor fields to the victim's own untouched live containers and compute the public fingerprint, then rebind the lexical ledger cell and mint custody.

proof_limits.narrowest_justified_statement: Against candidate c86ae335e the required non-forgeability invariant is NOT established; the lexical ledger-cell rebind alone still mints custody for an empty resolver without coordinated live-anchor replacement; HQ235's all-single-primitives-closed sub-claim is falsified; universal impossibility remains unproven.
